title: Saanj Winery Social House Grand Opening: Wine, Vibes, & Community
description: Hey Seattle, come through! Wine tastings, live music, curated bites, exclusive tote bag, and Seattle's first Black and Punjabi Social House.
long_description:
Hey Seattle, come through! Wine tastings, live music, curated bites, exclusive tote bag, and Seattle's first Black and Punjabi Social House.

About this Event

We're opening the doors to the Saanj Winery Social House and we want you here for it.

The Social House is a space built to bring people together through wine, conversation, creativity, and community. As Seattle's first Black and Punjabi Social House, this is more than a grand opening. It's a milestone years in the making. An afternoon of wine, music, community, and the space we've been building all summer.

Whether you've been following Saanj since day one or you're finding us for the first time, this is your chance to experience what we've been building.

Your $50 ticket includes:
🍷 Three guided wine tastings featuring Saanj Winery favorites
🧀 Curated appetizers throughout the evening
🎁 An exclusive Saanj swag bag
✨ First access to explore our brand-new Social House
🥁 Live Music from 2 Performers

Expect great music, incredible people, photo-worthy moments, and the laid-back energy that defines Saanj. Come meet the founders, connect with fellow wine lovers, and help us celebrate a milestone that’s been years in the making.

Event Details:
• Saturday | 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM
• Limited to only 55 guests
• Tickets: $50
• 21+ Only
• Featuring DJ KPHI
• Featuring Musical Artists DYLEUTH and Thomas Veli

Space is intentionally limited to keep the experience intimate. Grab your ticket early and come raise a glass with us as we celebrate the next chapter of Saanj Winery.

Wine to Fit Your Vibe.
